package targetcatalog

import (
	"context"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

const (
	maxDiscoveryStacks  = 16
	maxDiscoveryTargets = 200
)

var stackCodePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$`)

type Discover struct {
	Catalog repository.TargetDiscoveryCatalog
}

func (usecase Discover) Handle(ctx context.Context, inputs []string) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error) {
	if usecase.Catalog == nil || len(inputs) > maxDiscoveryStacks {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(inputs))
	stacks := make([]string, 0, len(inputs))
	for _, input := range inputs {
		stack := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input))
		if !stackCodePattern.MatchString(stack) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[stack]; !duplicate {
			seen[stack] = struct{}{}
			stacks = append(stacks, stack)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(stacks)
	definitions, err := usecase.Catalog.DiscoverByStacks(ctx, stacks, maxDiscoveryTargets)
	if err != nil || len(definitions) == 0 || len(definitions) > maxDiscoveryTargets {
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	seenTargets := make(map[string]struct{}, len(definitions))
	for _, definition := range definitions {
		ref, normalizeErr := domain.NormalizeTargetRef(definition.Ref)
		identity := domain.TargetIdentity(ref)
		if normalizeErr != nil || strings.TrimSpace(definition.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(definition.Description) == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seenTargets[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seenTargets[identity] = struct{}{}
	}
	return definitions, nil
}
